## Problem

## Environment and international context

If relevant: software version, language/script, time zone, region or geographic
assumption, and assistive technology. Do not include your home address or identity.

## Evidence and proposed acceptance criteria

Provide redacted output or public source links with dates and uncertainty where

## Privacy and source impact

Does this expose data, lose provenance, or misrepresent evidence? Describe only
non-sensitive impact. A public report is not a private reporting channel.
